title: Vaultify
description: Automatically scan and reset trial chamber vaults on a timer or on demand — no manual work needed.
body:
Vaultify automatically scans your world for every trial chamber vault and resets them on a configurable timer — no manual work, no kicking players out of chambers. Supports normal and ominous vaults separately. A world border is highly recommended.

Commands

Permission: vaultify.admin — Alias: /vf

/vf scan — scan within world border

/vf scan radius <n> — scan within custom radius

/vf scan cancel — cancel active scan

/vf reset [all | normal | ominous] — reset vault states

/vf delete [all | normal | ominous] — remove vault blocks from world

/vf undo — restore last delete

/vf list [normal | ominous] — list all tracked vaults

/vf interval [on | off | set <n>] — configure auto-reset timer

/vf data [export | import | status] — backup and restore vault data

Auto-Reset

Set an interval in minutes and Vaultify handles everything automatically. Toggle it on or off anytime without restarting.
